composition_variation: Show Nezuko Kamado in an age-appropriate fully covering pink patterned kimono and dark outer robe, standing beneath soft peach blossoms. Preserve her recognizable hair ornament and gentle eyes, with a calm friendly expression. She lightly gathers the sleeve edges in front of her body. Use delicate pastel cel shading, paper-grain textures, a pale mint garden wall, and blossoms concentrated below the clock area. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
